verses.text: A Psalm. A song for the Sabbath day. It is good to praise the LORD, and to sing praises to Your name, O Most High,

xrefs.text: Hallelujah! How good it is to sing praises to our God, how pleasant and lovely to praise Him!
Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
Speak to one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs. Sing and make music in your hearts to the Lord,
Hallelujah, for the LORD is good; sing praises to His name, for it is lovely.

verses.text: to proclaim Your loving devotion in the morning and Your faithfulness at night

xrefs.text: Because of the loving devotion of the LORD we are not consumed, for His mercies never fail.
A Maskil of Ethan the Ezrahite. I will sing of the loving devotion of the LORD forever; with my mouth I will proclaim Your faithfulness to all generations.
For the law was given through Moses; grace and truth came through Jesus Christ.

I will make known the LORD’s loving devotion and His praiseworthy acts, because of all that the LORD has done for us— the many good things for the house of Israel according to His great compassion and loving devotion.
The LORD decrees His loving devotion by day, and at night His song is with me as a prayer to the God of my life.

verses.text: with the ten-stringed harp and the melody of the lyre.

xrefs.text: Praise the LORD with the harp; make music to Him with ten strings.
David and all the Israelites were celebrating before God with all their might, with songs and on harps and lyres, with tambourines, cymbals, and trumpets.
a third shall be at the royal palace, and a third at the Foundation Gate, while all the others are to be in the courtyards of the house of the LORD.

At the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem, the Levites were sought out from all their homes and brought to Jerusalem to celebrate the joyous dedication with thanksgiving and singing, accompanied by cymbals, harps, and lyres.
The singers lead the way, the musicians follow after, among the maidens playing tambourines.

verses.text: For You, O LORD, have made me glad by Your deeds; I sing for joy at the works of Your hands.

xrefs.text: But thanks be to God, who always leads us triumphantly as captives in Christ and through us spreads everywhere the fragrance of the knowledge of Him.
You made him ruler of the works of Your hands; You have placed everything under his feet:
The LORD has done great things for us; we are filled with joy.
and my spirit rejoices in God my Savior!
Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: “My servants will eat, but you will go hungry; My servants will drink, but you will go thirsty; My servants will rejoice, but you will be put to shame.

verses.text: How great are Your works, O LORD, how deep are Your thoughts!

xrefs.text: O, the depth of the riches of the wisdom and knowledge of God! How unsearchable are His judgments, and untraceable His ways!
“For My thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways My ways,” declares the LORD.
Many, O LORD my God, are the wonders You have done, and the plans You have for us— none can compare to You— if I proclaim and declare them, they are more than I can count.
How precious to me are Your thoughts, O God, how vast is their sum!
Great is the LORD and greatly to be praised; His greatness is unsearchable.

verses.text: A senseless man does not know, and a fool does not understand,

xrefs.text: The natural man does not accept the things that come from the Spirit of God. For they are foolishness to him, and he cannot understand them, because they are spiritually discerned.
Take notice, O senseless among the people! O fools, when will you be wise?
I was senseless and ignorant; I was a brute beast before You.
“How long, O simple ones, will you love your simple ways? How long will scoffers delight in their scorn and fools hate knowledge?
For it is clear that wise men die, and the foolish and the senseless both perish and leave their wealth to others.

verses.text: that though the wicked sprout like grass, and all evildoers flourish, they will be forever destroyed.

xrefs.text: But the transgressors will all be destroyed; the future of the wicked will be cut off.
Surely You set them on slick ground; You cast them down into ruin.
Of David. Do not fret over those who do evil; do not envy those who do wrong.
I have seen a wicked, ruthless man flourishing like a well-rooted native tree,
Righteous are You, O LORD, when I plead before You. Yet about Your judgments I wish to contend with You: Why does the way of the wicked prosper? Why do all the faithless live at ease?

verses.text: But You, O LORD, are exalted forever!

xrefs.text: May they know that You alone, whose name is the LORD, are Most High over all the earth.
Now I know that the LORD is greater than all other gods, for He did this when they treated Israel with arrogance.”
And they began to shout, “This is the voice of a god, not a man!
About that time, King Herod reached out to harm some who belonged to the church.
They will perish, but You remain; they will all wear out like a garment. Like clothing You will change them, and they will be passed on.

verses.text: For surely Your enemies, O LORD, surely Your enemies will perish; all evildoers will be scattered.

xrefs.text: But the wicked and enemies of the LORD will perish like the glory of the fields. They will vanish; like smoke they will fade away.
You crushed Rahab like a carcass; You scattered Your enemies with Your mighty arm.
Your hand will apprehend all Your enemies; Your right hand will seize those who hate You.
and to grant relief to you who are oppressed and to us as well. This will take place when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with His mighty angels
For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. A song. God arises. His enemies are scattered, and those who hate Him flee His presence.

verses.text: But You have exalted my horn like that of a wild ox; with fine oil I have been anointed.

xrefs.text: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil; my cup overflows.
For You are the glory of their strength, and by Your favor our horn is exalted.
You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; therefore God, your God, has anointed you above your companions with the oil of joy.
Now it is God who establishes both us and you in Christ. He anointed us,
“All the horns of the wicked I will cut off, but the horns of the righteous will be exalted.”

verses.text: My eyes see the downfall of my enemies; my ears hear the wailing of my wicked foes.

xrefs.text: You will only see it with your eyes and witness the punishment of the wicked.
For He has delivered me from every trouble, and my eyes have looked in triumph on my foes.
My God of loving devotion will come to meet me; God will let me stare down my foes.
His heart is assured; he does not fear, until he looks in triumph on his foes.
Wait for the LORD and keep His way, and He will raise you up to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you will see it.

verses.text: The righteous will flourish like a palm tree, and grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

xrefs.text: He is like a tree planted by the waters that sends out its roots toward the stream. It does not fear when the heat comes, and its leaves are always green. It does not worry in a year of drought, nor does it cease to produce fruit.
He is like a tree planted by streams of water, yielding its fruit in season, whose leaf does not wither, and who prospers in all he does.
The trees of the LORD have their fill, the cedars of Lebanon that He planted,
But I am like an olive tree flourishing in the house of God; I trust in the loving devotion of God forever and ever.
I will be like the dew to Israel; he will blossom like the lily and take root like the cedars of Lebanon.

verses.text: Planted in the house of the LORD, they will flourish in the courts of our God.

xrefs.text: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To Him be the glory both now and to the day of eternity. Amen.

to console the mourners in Zion— to give them a crown of beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, and a garment of praise for a spirit of despair. So they will be called oaks of righteousness, the planting of the LORD, that He may be glorified.
so that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith. Then you, being rooted and grounded in love,
For if we have been united with Him like this in His death, we will certainly also be united with Him in His resurrection.
Then all your people will be righteous; they will possess the land forever; they are the branch of My planting, the work of My hands, so that I may be glorified.

verses.text: In old age they will still bear fruit; healthy and green they will remain,

xrefs.text: Even to your old age, I will be the same, and I will bear you up when you turn gray. I have made you, and I will carry you; I will sustain you and deliver you.

He is like a tree planted by the waters that sends out its roots toward the stream. It does not fear when the heat comes, and its leaves are always green. It does not worry in a year of drought, nor does it cease to produce fruit.
Even when I am old and gray, do not forsake me, O God, until I proclaim Your power to the next generation, Your might to all who are to come.
filled with the fruit of righteousness that comes through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.
He cuts off every branch in Me that bears no fruit, and every branch that does bear fruit, He prunes to make it even more fruitful.

verses.text: to proclaim, “The LORD is upright; He is my Rock, and in Him there is no unrighteousness.”

xrefs.text: The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer. My God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.
What then shall we say? Is God unjust? Certainly not!
He alone is my rock and my salvation; He is my fortress; I will not be shaken.
Therefore listen to me, O men of understanding. Far be it from God to do wrong, and from the Almighty to act unjustly.
He is the Rock, His work is perfect; all His ways are just. A God of faithfulness without injustice, righteous and upright is He.
